goal: Calibrate a conservative PBR response for the inherited HD body without changing structure or animation.
steps: Inventory packed materials and texture links
Set conservative roughness, specular IOR level and normal strength scalar values
Render matched eight-angle baseline and candidate turntables
Fingerprint and compare source versus candidate
observations: The received HD LOD materials use packed base-color and normal textures, but their roughness scalar was 1.0.
The calibrated material retains the original color/normal texture links and provides more controlled normal-map response under the matched neutral turntable.
All LOD geometry, UVs, weights, seven action signatures and packed image bytes are identical to the baseline; only copied material identities and scalar shader controls differ.
This is a conservative visual study, not final material approval and not a solution for the unresolved mouth topology.
